# BuildMeasure

> Reference-backed construction and DIY calculators with transparent formulas, visible assumptions, and metric and imperial inputs.

Canonical site: https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/

## Calculators

- [Concrete Calculator](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/concrete-calculator): rectangular slab volume, waste allowance, cubic yards, cubic meters, and 40/60/80 lb bag estimates.
- [Paint Calculator](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/paint-calculator): walls, ceilings, measured openings, coats, coverage, and complete containers.
- [Tile Calculator](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/tile-calculator): area, waste, tile layout, full boxes, and purchase quantity.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/gravel-calculator): volume, adjustable density, weight, tons, tonnes, and complete bags.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/mulch-calculator): bed volume, installed depth, package volume, and complete bags.

## Guides and methodology

- [How Many Bags of Concrete Do I Need?](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/guides/how-many-bags-of-concrete)
- [How to Estimate Construction Materials](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/guides/material-estimating-basics)
- [Calculation Methodology](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/methodology)
- [About BuildMeasure](https://buildmeasure.hosy-sthdr.workers.dev/about)

## Usage note

BuildMeasure produces planning estimates, not structural, regulatory, contractual, or supplier approval. Verify dimensions, product data, waste assumptions, local requirements, and purchase quantities before construction or ordering.
